limitations: This report deliberately does not complete task31, root goal, global coverage, final no-skip generator gates or local commit acceptance.
Fresh official fetch failed; local captures are read evidence with fingerprints, not verified fresh remote publisher pages or instructions.
Ghost/WordPress CMS authorization, refine detailed form validation, OWASP CSRF/cookie/authorization, Spring/Next official contents remain unverified.
No test/build/application/network/browser/service/DB/Git operations executed here. Prior GREEN log reading is attributed, not a current rerun.
Source partials and grep-only hits outside recorded read ranges do not establish semantics; raw reference response metadata does not establish body content or transform equivalence.
No actual public RED was observed by this reader; no candidate/proved vulnerability, SSRF exploit, privacy leak or exhaustion was asserted.
Physical wheel, actual IME/focus/nested-dialog behavior, Set-Cookie ordering, production configs/data/loads and socket/proxy/SNI/TLS behavior remain UNKNOWN.
URL/DNS validation is not socket binding proof; post-buffer response limit is not memory allocation bound.
No full 118-file Blog snapshot coverage or live Blog coverage; only 8 targeted snapshot source files.

Hashes/byte counts are exact local observations; publication/version is null unless actually present in read capture; WordPress date/version feature mentions are not current publisher release certification.
